title: Clinic-Cancellation Credit on Self-Pay Visit Package Reinstatements
content:
On the reinstatement of a Self-Pay Visit Package, the clinic-disruption credit counts the package-funded appointments the clinic itself cancelled — appointment cancellations in the patient's Appointment Series history recorded with the cancellation reason "clinic cancelled" and funded by the self-pay package: **$20.00** for two or more, **$10.00** for exactly one, none for none. The credit is subtracted from the reinstatement charge.

**Basis questions**

*Is the credit per cancellation?* No. One clinic cancellation gives $10.00; two or more give $20.00, however many there are.

*Which cancellations are counted?* Those recorded with the reason "clinic cancelled" on appointments funded by the self-pay package. Cancellations the patient made, and appointments funded by an insured plan of care, a workers' compensation referral or a membership, are not counted.

| Clinic-cancelled package-funded appointments | Credit |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | $10.00 |
| 2 or more | $20.00 |

*Hypothetical:* a patient with three clinic-cancelled package-funded appointments on the Appointment Series receives a $20.00 credit.
